proposed_widenings.name: passive_on_hit_rider (class feature family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Colossus Slayer is a passive weapon-hit rider on the class feature record. The only class feature family is 'activation', which requires an activationCost + use_count resource + resetCadence + effect. Colossus Slayer has none of these — it is always-on (while chosen) and fires passively on each qualifying weapon hit. Forcing it into 'activation' would misrepresent the mechanic entirely.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it's missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_on_attack_rider (class feature family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Horde Breaker fires when the ranger *makes* a weapon attack (before resolution, not on hit). There is no 'on_attack_window' atom — only 'on_hit_window'. The trigger is pre-resolution, granting a second optional weapon attack against a different creature. This is not 'activation' and not 'on_hit_trigger'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.

proposed_widenings.name: choose_one_of_N_options (top-level class feature choice structure)
proposed_widenings.justification: Hunter's Prey is not a single feature — it is a container that grants one of two sub-options, replaceable on Short or Long Rest. There is no vocabulary in UnitRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, or ClassFeatureMechanics for 'choose one of these variants, swappable on rest'. Both individual options and the choice structure itself require new surface support.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

proposed_widenings.name: hp_below_max_predicate (conditional filter on damage_on_hit)
proposed_widenings.justification: Colossus Slayer's +1d8 only applies if the target is currently missing HP. This is a runtime predicate on the creature's HP state that gates whether the rider fires. No existing atom or filter variant captures this check. The closest existing concept is a save gate, but this is a passive HP-state check, not a save.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it's missing any of its Hit Points

proposed_widenings.name: on_attack_window
proposed_widenings.justification: Horde Breaker's trigger is 'when you make an attack with a weapon' — before attack roll resolution. The v4 atom inventory has on_hit_window and on_miss_window (post-resolution) but no pre-resolution attack window. This is a distinct timing point needed for Horde Breaker and analogous features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack...

notes: Neither Colossus Slayer nor Horde Breaker fits ClassFeatureActivationMechanics. Both are passive riders on weapon attacks with no activation cost or use-count resource in the standard sense. The top-level feature is also a choose-one-of-two-options container with rest-based swap, which has no surface representation. Three distinct structural gaps: (1) no passive rider family for class features, (2) no choose-N-options container, (3) Colossus Slayer has an HP-state predicate with no atom equivalent. Dhall/JSON/trace intentionally omitted.
